claims.statement: Partner packages follow a standardized directory structure with Python package under langchain_provider_name/, chat_models/ containing base.py with ChatModel implementation, data/ containing auto-generated _profiles.py and provider-specific profile_augmentations.toml, and tests/ directory with unit_tests and integration_tests subdirectories following the same chat_models structure.

ChatModel implementations must inherit from BaseChatModel and provide: _llm_type property returning provider identifier, _generate() and _stream() synchronous methods returning ChatResult/ChatGenerationChunk, _agenerate() and _astream() async variants, plus model configuration attributes (model identifier, api_key, temperature, max_tokens).

Partner packages must inherit from langchain_tests.unit_tests.ChatModelUnitTests and langchain_tests.integration_tests.ChatModelIntegrationTests for unit_tests/chat_models/test_standard.py and integration_tests/chat_models/test_standard.py respectively, providing chat_model_class property and chat_model_params fixture for test configuration.

Model profiles are organized in data/_profiles.py (auto-generated from provider registry) and profile_augmentations.toml (provider-specific overrides) defining model capabilities including context_window, supports_vision, supports_tool_calling, supports_structured_output, and pricing information.
